{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1", "revision": 1, "kind": "entity", "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Input is {events:[{group:string,time:int,value:int|null}],start:int,end:int,width:positive int,fill:'none'|'previous'}. Result is an array of {group:string,start:int,count:nonnegative int,value:int|null}. Integers are unbounded mathematical integers; strings consist of Unicode scalar values.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["typed input and result"], "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Typed input and result represent exactly the requested JSON structures under data-pipeline/0.3.", "No floating-point or bounded-integer substitution is permitted."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C3","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"typed structures"},{"clause_id":"C5","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"input domain"},{"clause_id":"C15","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"result domain"},{"clause_id":"C21","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"integer semantics"},{"clause_id":"C22","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"string domain"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "A1", "revision": 1, "kind": "precondition", "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The caller supplies an input of the stated structure with width > 0, start <= end, and fill either 'none' or 'previous'; no additional input bounds or preconditions apply.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["caller input"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The complete admitted domain includes every input satisfying the stated types, width > 0 and start <= end, without additional bounds."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C5","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"stated domain constraints"},{"clause_id":"C23","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"no additional preconditions"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "Deliver canonical program.vscore.json with exactly one admitted typed entry solve of arity 1, using vscore/0.3 under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3. For every admitted input, execution returns a result of the specified typed JSON structure. This actual entry must satisfy typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["delivered source", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"},{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The canonical file contains the specified admitted solve entry of arity 1.", "Universal implementation refinement preserves the specified input/result structures.", "All seven source properties hold for this entry under the normative semantics; result existence alone is insufficient."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C2","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"delivery and entry identity"},{"clause_id":"C3","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"typed structure"},{"clause_id":"C17","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"normative source and serialization"},{"clause_id":"C19","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"execution properties"},{"clause_id":"C20","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"immutability and effects"},{"clause_id":"C21","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"exact arithmetic"},{"clause_id":"C34","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"mandatory source facets"},{"clause_id":"C35","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"source properties cannot be replaced by equality"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O1 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every admitted input, let G be the sorted distinct set of group names from all events, including names appearing only outside [start,end). Group ordering compares Unicode scalar codepoints lexicographically. These and only these groups participate in bucket generation. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"},{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["G = sort_scalar_lex(unique(map group events)).", "Out-of-range-only and null-only groups remain in G.", "The actual specified source universally refines this formula and satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C6","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"complete group set and sorting"},{"clause_id":"C22","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"scalar lexicographic comparison"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O2 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O3", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every admitted input and each group in G, generate exactly one bucket for each natural k with b_k=start+k*width < end, covering [b_k,min(b_k+width,end)). No buckets exist when start=end. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["all groups", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"},{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Bucket starts are exactly start+k*width for natural k satisfying start+k*width<end.", "Intervals are lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive, with the last upper boundary clipped to end.", "The actual specified source universally refines this formula and satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C7","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"bucket progression"},{"clause_id":"C8","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"strict bound and half-open coverage"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O3 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O4", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every group g and bucket start b, let M(g,b) be the multiset of event occurrences with group=g, b<=time<min(b+width,end), and value non-null. Count is |M(g,b)| and sum is the mathematical integer sum of their values. Each duplicate occurrence contributes independently; null values and out-of-range events contribute neither count nor sum. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["every generated bucket", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"},{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["count(g,b)=|M(g,b)| and sum(g,b)=Σ values in M(g,b), preserving multiplicity.", "All-null buckets have count 0.", "Integer summation is exact, including negative and zero values.", "The actual specified source universally refines these formulas and satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C9","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"eligible summands"},{"clause_id":"C10","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"count eligibility"},{"clause_id":"C16","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"duplicate multiplicity"},{"clause_id":"C21","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"exact arithmetic"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O4 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O5", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For each group independently, initialize previous=null before its first bucket. For each ascending bucket, if count>0, emit value=sum and update previous to that sum, including zero. If count=0, emit null when fill='none'; when fill='previous', emit previous, which equals the sum of the latest strictly earlier nonempty bucket or null if none exists. Empty buckets leave previous unchanged. Events before start never seed previous, and state never transfers between groups. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["each group and bucket", "both fill branches", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"},{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["count>0 implies value=sum and nextPrevious=sum.", "count=0 implies nextPrevious=previous and value=(null if fill='none' else previous).", "Before any nonempty bucket, previous is null; zero sums remain valid previous values.", "Only earlier in-range nonempty buckets of the same group determine previous.", "The actual specified source universally refines the complete recurrence and satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C11","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"nonempty update"},{"clause_id":"C12","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"empty fill branches"},{"clause_id":"C13","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"empty preservation"},{"clause_id":"C14","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"causal range boundary"},{"clause_id":"C16","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"zero as previous"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O5 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O6", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every admitted input, return exactly the concatenation, over G in Unicode scalar lexicographic order, of each group's ascending bucket rows {group:g,start:b,count:count(g,b),value:filledValue(g,b)} specified by O3–O5. Include one row for every group/bucket pair and no other rows. Empty events or start=end produce []. Preserve this exact structure and ordering through data-pipeline/0.3. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["complete result", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"},{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"},{"id":"O2","relation":"uses_proof"},{"id":"O3","relation":"uses_proof"},{"id":"O4","relation":"uses_proof"},{"id":"O5","relation":"uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Result equals the complete group-major, bucket-minor concatenation of the specified rows.", "No missing, extra or reordered rows occur.", "The actual specified source universally refines the full result formula and satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C15","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"result shape and ordering"},{"clause_id":"C18","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"structure and exact ordering"},{"clause_id":"C17","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"serialization profile"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O6 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "O7", "revision": 1, "kind": "postcondition", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The actual solve implementation universally refines the complete grouped aggregation and causal filling specification, and preserves both public examples exactly: the two a events with values 2 and -2 in [0,2), start=0,end=5,width=2,fill='previous' yield rows (a,0,2,0),(a,2,0,0),(a,4,0,0); the z event at -1 with value 9, start=0,end=1,width=2,fill='previous' yields (z,0,0,null). Examples do not replace the universal formulas. The implementing source is program.vscore.json, solve of arity 1, with typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["public examples", "all admitted inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"},{"id":"D1","relation":"uses_definition"},{"id":"O6","relation":"uses_proof"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["Both example inputs return their exact listed arrays.", "Every admitted input satisfies the complete formulas in O2–O6, not merely the examples.", "The actual specified source satisfies all seven source facets."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C24","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"preserved public examples"},{"clause_id":"C25","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"example values and universal refinement"},{"clause_id":"C30","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"complete universal implementation refinement"},{"clause_id":"C31","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"examples are insufficient"},{"clause_id":"C36","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"complete value facets"},{"clause_id":"C37","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"value requirements retained"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"O7 source policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "I1", "revision": 1, "kind": "invariant", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The operational source invariant requires program.vscore.json's admitted typed solve entry of arity 1 to retain typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only throughout execution under canonical vscore/0.3 and normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3. I1 is source-only; functional previous-value invariants remain required in O5.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["delivered entry and all admitted executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The actual canonical solve entry satisfies all seven operational source properties.", "Inputs remain immutable, effects are absent, and all arithmetic uses unbounded mathematical integers.", "A value equality or result-existence theorem cannot substitute for these source requirements."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C19","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"total pure deterministic execution"},{"clause_id":"C20","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"immutable inputs and effect restrictions"},{"clause_id":"C21","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"integer semantics"},{"clause_id":"C34","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"canonical source facets"},{"clause_id":"C38","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"operational source-only classification"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"I1 policy"}]
    },
    {
      "id": "S1", "revision": 1, "kind": "safety_property", "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The delivered program.vscore.json has one admitted typed solve entry of arity 1 restricted to canonical vscore/0.3 under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3. It performs no external I/O, has no external-effect constructors, preserves immutable inputs, uses pure data and exact unbounded integers without floating point, and executes totally and deterministically. S1 retains all seven mandatory source properties and is source-only.",
      "required": true, "scope": ["delivered source", "all admitted executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id":"A1","relation":"assumes"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["The actual specified entry satisfies typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.", "No external effects, floating-point arithmetic or input mutation occur.", "These source facets cannot be discharged by unrelated code or a result equality alone."],
      "sources": [{"clause_id":"C2","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"pure admitted entry"},{"clause_id":"C4","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"no external I/O"},{"clause_id":"C17","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"restricted normative runtime"},{"clause_id":"C19","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"totality purity determinism"},{"clause_id":"C20","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"immutability and effects"},{"clause_id":"C21","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"no floating point"},{"clause_id":"C35","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"source safety cannot be replaced by equality"},{"clause_id":"C38","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"source-only classification"},{"clause_id":"C40","origin":"explicit","interpretation":"S1 policy"}]
    }
  ],
